channel_scope.reason: The 120-127 all-channel target_root_hash test failed only through a total3/4 surface with zero preserving Sage factors. This preregistration isolates the total2 first-fall route before adding a separate total3/4 pre-factor discriminator.

pre_factor_gate.name: pre_factor_nonvacuous_hit_root_proxy
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaf has at least one known hit root before factorization

primary_root_policy.name: target_root_hash
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 128-135 from the 120-127 total2-only diagnostic: 2/2 preserving, zero false positives, 2/2 scan-below-rho, 2/2 direct-below-rho, and chosen root 161 on both total2 selected surfaces
algorithm: rank candidate root hyperplanes by target-scoped public fingerprint digest
stop at the first public-zero root hyperplane
charge all selector work plus root-scan or direct-root accounting

baseline_root_policies.name: summax_low_root_norm_target_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: posthoc best static public policy on the 120-127 total2 selected surfaces

baseline_root_policies.name: summax_sage_low_constant_target_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: frozen static public policy selected from <=87 rows

promotion_condition: After generating the 128-135 total2 strict signature and pre-factor manifest, factor only total2 gate-selected surfaces and score target_root_hash. Count as a total2 scan-positive promotion only if all total2 gate-selected surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and scan-below-rho. Count as a weaker total2 direct-root-positive result only if all total2 gate-selected surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and direct-below-rho.
non_claims: This does not promote total3/4 surfaces.
This does not claim end-to-end ECDLP recovery faster than Pollard rho.
This does not claim a public total3/4 discriminator has been found.
